prompt: Announce the neighborhood watch's monthly patrol as a WWE faction entrance. They have matching windbreakers.
response:
**(The streetlights on Elm Avenue suddenly cut out. The cul-de-sac goes pitch black. The faint sound of a walkie-talkie clicks over the neighborhood PA system.)**

*KCHHHHK.* “Bravo Team, we are oscar-mike. I repeat, the perimeter is hot.” *KCHHHHK.*

**(Glass shatters! A monstrous heavy metal riff drops, accompanied by the blare of a mega-bullhorn!)**

**NEIGHBORHOOD ANNOUNCER:** 
"BAH GAWD! WAIT A MINUTE! Listen to this pop from the subdivision! IT’S THEM! THE UNDISPUTED, REIGNING, DEFENDING CHAMPIONS OF PROPERTY VALUES! IT’S... *THE CUL-DE-SAC SYNDICATE!*"

**(A thick cloud of smoke rolls out from Gary’s malfunctioning BBQ grill. Bursting through the smoke, walking in a perfect, aggressive V-formation, are five neighbors. The streetlights flick back on to reveal their gear.)**

**ANNOUNCER:** 
"Look at them! They are decked out in the signature faction gear! Matching, high-visibility, 100% water-resistant nylon windbreakers! You can hear the deafening *SWISH-SWISH-SWISH* of the fabric with every step! That breathable mesh lining means they can patrol all night without breaking a sweat! Those reflective stripes are glaring under the moonlight!"

**(The leader of the faction, "Tactical" Todd, marches to the center of the intersection. He’s holding a Maglite flashlight like it’s the WWE Heavyweight Championship. He violently clicks it onto the 'strobe' setting, then grabs a microphone.)**

**TACTICAL TODD:**
*(Pacing furiously, pointing at random driveways)*
"Listen up, loiterers! You hooligans rolling through stop signs! You kids thinking about ding-dong-ditching the Henderson residence! You look at us, and you look at these matching zip-ups! This right here?! This is the uniform of justice! 

We didn’t come out here tonight to bake casseroles. We didn’t come out here to talk about the weather! It is the First Friday of the month, which means THE SYNDICATE is on patrol! 

You think you can leave your trash cans by the curb 24 hours after pickup?! *NOT ON OUR WATCH!* 
You think you can play pickleball with the boombox past 9:30 PM?! *NOT ON OUR WATCH!*

We’ve got the clipboards! We’ve got the local precinct on speed dial! We’ve got thermoses full of lukewarm decaf and we are ready for a FIGHT!"

**(The rest of the faction flexes. "Big" Brenda holds up a pair of binoculars. "Enforcer" Dave adjusts the Velcro cuffs on his windbreaker with a menacing rip.)**

**TACTICAL TODD:** 
"So to every speeding minivan, to every un-leashed Goldendoodle, and to every suspicious shadow in the park... recognize the windbreakers! Acknowledge your Patrolmen! 

And if you’re not down with a safe, secure, and quiet subdivision... THE CUL-DE-SAC SYNDICATE HAS TWO WORDS FOR YA!"

**(The entire team points their flashlights at the sky and screams in unison:)**

**THE SYNDICATE:**
*"MOVE OUT!"*

**(The heavy metal theme music blasts again. Todd drops the mic. The faction turns and begins their slow, menacing *swish-swish-swishing* power-walk down the sidewalk as the neighborhood watches in stunned silence.)**
